reason: P07-07 replaces the operator singleton target configuration with an explicit server allowlist and authenticated metadata-only target catalog. Startup/readiness and four legacy financial routes now use the registry; single-firm config remains supported and multiple targets never select the first. SubscriptionTargetsTests cover config ambiguity, identity/duplicate destinations, production TLS, Development numeric-loopback exception, two real PostgreSQL firms, MFA/catalog privacy, legacy write guards, all56-table snapshots, wrong markers/roles and one-firm outage. SubscriptionOperatorTests preserve provisioning, login/MFA/revocation/CSRF and financial replay/correction behavior; SubscriptionTests and SubscriptionAccessTests preserve Owner privacy, immutable ledger and payment/read-only coordination. Existing operator UI/common API suites cover unchanged single-firm callers and errors. No Server/Web source, deploy/network/schema/grant or dependency changes; normal8080 runtime source/image are preserved. Operator image packaging and isolated startup acceptance are required; normal Compose rebuild/DB restart is unrelated.
